donts: Do not continue applying the rescinded NHLBI-specific budget caps from NOT-HL-24-008
Do not assume institutional templates have been updated automatically
dos: Use standard NIH SBIR/STTR budget guidance unless NHLBI publishes new guidance
Review any in-progress NHLBI SBIR/STTR budgets that cited NOT-HL-24-008
Watch for a replacement NHLBI notice on SBIR/STTR budget policy
eligibility_tldr: Affects small businesses preparing SBIR or STTR applications to NHLBI that were following the rescinded budget guidance. Applicants should defer to standard NIH SBIR/STTR budget rules unless NHLBI issues replacement guidance.
issuing_orgs: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
purpose_tldr: Rescinds NOT-HL-24-008, NHLBI's prior policies regarding budget guidelines for SBIR and STTR applications. The rescission is effective immediately; the 2024 NHLBI-specific SBIR/STTR budget guidance no longer applies.
title: Notice to Rescind NOT-HL-24-008 "NHLBI Announces New Policies Regarding Budget Guidelines for SBIR/STTR Applications"
